title: 第一卷 第4章 鸡蛋不能给
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

野菜种子是最容易找到的，山上到处都有，种出来拿到镇上卖，多少能换几个钱。

草药也行，金银花和柴胡的种子她今天在山上见到了，明天可以采一些回来种在灵田里。

还有一样东西沈鹿溪一直惦记着。

今天上山的时候她在坡地更高的位置看到了几棵野茶树，叶子嫩绿，长势不错。

前世逃难路上，她见过南方的茶商收购野茶，品相好的能卖出高价。

村里的人不喝茶，觉得那玩意儿是苦叶子，没人当回事。

可镇上的茶铺收。

明天上山，除了采草药，还得摘一些茶叶回来。

沈鹿溪合上书，又在空间里待了一会儿，把灵田里的苗浇了一遍泉水，才退了出来。

回到小屋的时候，门外传来王桂花的声音。

“老二家的！过来！”

沈鹿溪推开门，看见母亲柳荞娘正朝正房走过去，脚步有些急。

她跟了上去。

正房堂屋里，祖母王桂花坐在太师椅上，手边放着一碗茶，赵翠屏站在旁边，嘴角挂着一丝笑，那种看好戏的笑。

柳荞娘走进去，低声喊了一句：“娘。”

王桂花端起茶碗喝了一口，不紧不慢地开口：“后天镇上赶集，你把家里攒的鸡蛋拿去卖了，换了钱交给我。”

柳荞娘一愣：“娘，那些鸡蛋是留给小满补身子的……”

“补什么身子！一个赔钱货养的小崽子，还想吃鸡蛋？”王桂花把茶碗往桌上一顿，“金宝在镇上读书，笔墨纸砚哪样不要钱？你们二房吃家里的喝家里的，出几个鸡蛋怎么了？”

赵翠屏在旁边帮腔：“就是，弟妹你也太小气了。金宝可是咱们沈家唯一读书的孩子，将来考上功名，你们二房也跟着沾光不是？”

沈鹿溪站在门口，把这番话听了个齐全。

沈金宝读的什么书，她前世清清楚楚。

那小子根本没去过私塾，王桂花给的“读书钱”全让他拿去赌了。

赵翠屏知不知道不好说，王桂花是真被蒙在鼓里。

柳荞娘还在为难，沈鹿溪开口了。

“奶，鸡蛋的事先不急。我倒是有个事想问问。”

屋里几个人都看过来。

王桂花皱眉：“问什么？大人说话小孩子插什么嘴。”

沈鹿溪没理这茬，径直说了下去：“金宝哥在镇上读书，读的是哪家私塾？先生姓什么？我改天去镇上，顺便替奶去看看金宝哥的功课。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wild vegetable seeds are the easiest to find. They are found everywhere in the mountains. If you grow them and sell them in the town, you can get some money.

Herbal medicines are also fine. She saw the seeds of honeysuckle and bupleurum on the mountain today. She can pick some and plant them in the spiritual field tomorrow.

There is something else that Shen Luxi has been thinking about.

When she went up the mountain today, she saw several wild tea trees on the higher slopes. The leaves were green and they were growing well.

On the way to escape in her previous life, she had seen tea merchants in the south buying wild tea. Good quality tea could be sold at a high price.

People in the village don't drink tea because they think the tea is bitter leaves, so no one takes it seriously.

But the tea shop in town collects it.

When we go up the mountain tomorrow, in addition to picking herbs, we also have to pick some tea leaves.

Shen Luxi closed the book and stayed in the space for a while, watering the seedlings in the spiritual field with spring water before retreating.

When I returned to the hut, Wang Guihua's voice came from outside the door.

"From the second brother's house! Come here!"

Shen Luxi opened the door and saw his mother, Liu Qiaoniang, walking towards the main room, her steps a little hasty.

She followed.

In the main hall, grandmother Wang Guihua was sitting on the chair of the grand master, with a bowl of tea in her hand. Zhao Cuiping was standing next to her, with a smile on her lips, the kind of smile that makes people watch a good show.

Liu Qiaoniang walked in and called out in a low voice: "Mom."

Wang Guihua picked up the tea bowl and took a sip, and said slowly: "The day after tomorrow, when we go to the market in town, you take the eggs you saved at home and sell them, and give them to me in exchange for the money."

Liu Qiao Niang was startled: "Mom, those eggs are for Xiao Man to replenish his health..."

"What's wrong with you? A kid who was raised at a loss still wants to eat eggs?" Wang Guihua put the tea bowl on the table and said, "Jinbao is studying in the town. How can he get pens, inks, paper and inkstones for free? Your second wife eats and drinks from home. What's wrong with the few eggs?"

Zhao Cuiping spoke up from the side: "You are too stingy, brother and sister. Jinbao is the only child in our Shen family who is studying. If he is admitted to the imperial examination in the future, your second wife will also benefit from it, right?"

Shen Luxi stood at the door and listened to all these words.

She clearly knew what books Shen Jinbao read in her previous life.

That kid had never been to a private school, so he used all the "study money" Wang Guihua gave him to gamble.

It's hard to say whether Zhao Cuiping knew this, but Wang Guihua was really kept in the dark.

While Liu Qiaoniang was still in trouble, Shen Luxi spoke.

"There's no rush about milk and eggs. I do have something to ask."

Several people in the room looked over.

Wang Guihua frowned: "What are you asking? Why do children get in the way when adults are talking?"

Shen Luxi ignored this and continued: "Brother Jinbao is studying in the town. Which private school is he studying at? What is your surname? I will go to town another day and take the place of my wife to check on Brother Jinbao's homework."
